您想去宝物室吗？只有公会会长，也就是您，才有权进入。

scripts.text: Enter Treasure room.
scripts.translation: 进入宝物室

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
Would you like to employ the services of a Kafra? You will need ^5533FF10,000 Zeny^000000 to do so...
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
您想雇佣一名卡普拉职员吗？为此需要支付^5533FF10,000 Zeny^000000...

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
Would you like to dismiss the current Kafra?
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
您想解雇目前的卡普拉职员吗？

scripts.text: Employ Kafra.
scripts.translation: 雇佣卡普拉

scripts.text: Dismissal
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
Please follow me through the secret passage way.
You must pull down on the secret switch in order to get out.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
请跟我穿过这条秘密通道。您必须拉下秘密开关才能出去。

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
Have I done anything wrong? If I did, will you please forgive me?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
我做错了什么吗？
如果有，请您原谅我，好吗？

scripts.text: Dismiss
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
You have created a contract with the Kafra Staff Company.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
您已与卡普拉公司签订契约。

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
It's unfortunate that I won't be able to serve your guild anymore....
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
很遗憾，不能继续为贵公会服务了...

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
How do you do? I'm here to provide you with helpful service! I'll do the best I can to serve you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
您好！我是来为您提供便利服务的！
我会尽心尽力为您服务。

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
I am waiting for my master.  Brave adventurer, follow your destiny!
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
我在等待我的主人。勇敢的冒险者，追随你的命运吧！

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
You're not ^5533FF{0}^000000! I am here to follow ^5533FF{1}^000000's command only

[ Thefton ]
I am here to follow ^5533FF{0}^000000's command! Hey! Your not even a part of the guild!!
Where are the guardians? Destroy these intruders!
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
我是来听从^5533FF{0}^000000的命令！喂！你根本不是公会成员！！
守卫们在哪里？消灭这些入侵者！

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
As you wish, master.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
遵命，主人。

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
Master, you don't have a contract with the Kafra Staff Company.
In order to hire a Kafra, you must first learn the Guild skill ^5533FFContract With Kafra^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
会长，您还没有与卡普拉公司签订契约。要雇佣卡普拉职员，必须先学会公会技能^5533FF与卡普拉签订契约^000000。

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
The goods are produced everyday.
You should get them whenever you can because they might dissapear if you take them at the wrong time.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
宝物每天都会产出，请尽早领取。若错过时机，宝物可能会消失。

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
As you wish Master.  But I suggest we get a Kafra as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
遵命，会长。不过，我建议尽快雇佣一名卡普拉职员！

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
Master, I think you should keep the current Kafra Staff because she is already trying her best to serve us
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
会长，我建议留下现在的卡普拉职员，她已经在尽力为我们服务了。

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
Master, you do not have enough money to employ a Kafra. Employment has been cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
会长，您的钱不够雇佣卡普拉职员，雇佣已取消。

scripts.text:
[ Kafra Staff ]
Thank you master, I'll do my best! ^^.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉职员]
谢谢您，主人！
我会尽力的！^^

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
The Kafra has been dismissed.  But... we should really get a Kafra as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
卡普拉职员已经被解雇了。但是...我们真的应该尽快再雇一名卡普拉职员！

scripts.text:
[ Thefton ]
I think the Kafra Staff will benefit our guild members.
scripts.translation:
[瑟夫顿]
我想，卡普拉职员会给公会成员带来不少便利。
